## FAQ: Business Loan Eligibility
To qualify for a Darwix Business Loan, your business must be operationally active for at least 12 months. Your annual revenue must exceed $120,000 (approx. $10,000/month). Contact loan manager at manager@darwixcapital.com or call +1-800-555-0199 for help.

## Rates and Interest Terms
Darwix Capital offers fixed APRs between 7.5% and 18.5% based on business credit score. Interest rate is locked for the entire tenure (12 to 60 months). There are zero hidden fees, but a 2% origination fee applies at disbursement.

## FAQ: Business Loan Eligibility
To qualify for a Darwix Business Loan, your business must be operationally active for at least 12 months. Your annual revenue must exceed $120,000.

## Early Payoff and Prepayment Penalties
Borrowers can prepay their business loan at any time after 6 months without any prepayment penalty or early termination fee. Payoffs within the first 6 months incur a flat 1.5% administrative fee.

## Personal Loans and Out-of-Scope Services
Darwix Capital exclusively provides commercial and business financing. We do NOT offer personal loans, residential mortgages, auto loans, or student loans. Any personal loan inquiries must be politely declined and redirected.

## Required Documentation
To complete loan pre-qualification, the applicant must submit: (1) 6 months of recent business bank statements, (2) Business tax returns for the past 2 years, and (3) Government-issued photo ID of primary owner (SSN/Tax ID will be verified securely).
